items.docs: Retrieve the status of a Tradeverifyd Report Request by id.

Creates a request for generating Tradeverifyd compliance reports. TASA reports require entity_id, CPR/CGR reports require shipment_id. TASA reports can optionally include hs_code.Currently only TASA reports are fully implemented.

Retrieve a Tradeverifyd Report Request Details by id.

Args:
    report_id: UUID of the report.

Returns:
    ReportDetailResponse object:
        id: UUID
        requested_ts: datetime
        completed_ts: Optional[datetime]
        report_type: str
        report_status: str
        report_name: Optional[str]

Retrieve the contents of a Tradeverifyd Report by report id.

Args:
    

    report_id: UUID of the report to retrieve content for.

    report_supplement: Optional supplement name to retrieve. Currently only "extended-graph" is supported. Only available for CGR reports in JSON format.
    If the report_supplement is provided, only the supplement is returned, otherwise the report is returned in the format specified by the accept header.

    accept: Content format preference. Supported values:
